notes.title: ✨️Dev Update✨️
notes.content: [p]📣 DEV UPDATE: 135 Players & 8 Hours Average Playtime — You’re Incredible [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Hey Seekers 👋 [/p][p][/p][p]I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you — Seekers: Enlightenment now has 135 unique players, and you're averaging nearly 8 hours of playtime each. That’s wild. [/p][p][/p][p]🎮 A huge shoutout to the folks replaying the game, pushing through Time Attack, and coming back for more — you're the heart of this game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]--- [/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ What’s Next? [/p][p][/p][p]I’m currently working on: [/p][p][/p][p]Daily challenges - it will change the way you play the game [/p][p][/p][p]Chaos Trials Mode – A whole new layer of challenge. [/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 2 DLC – 20+ levels of new content coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 2 dlc content - new characters for chaos trials l, new skins, and new characters for chaos trials![/p][p][/p][p]The goal is to reward those of you who stuck around, and give new players even more reasons to explore deeper.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]--- [/p][p][/p][p]💬 Want to Help? [/p][p][/p][p]Leave a review – even just a few words helps a lot [/p][p][/p][p]Share the game – with a friend, streamer, or community [/p][p][/p][p]Tell me what you’d love to see next – I’m always listening[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being here. Your support means everything — we’re just getting started![/p][p][/p][p]🌀 —Mega Morph Games[/p][p]Solo Dev of Seekers : Enlightenment [/p]

notes.title: Seekers: Enlightenment (Bug fixes)
notes.content: * When using ivy's ability "Dash" her stamina wouldn't regenerate at all but now the player regains their stamina back after using one of the abilities that Ivy has

notes.title: Seekers: Enlightenment Bug Fixes
notes.content:
* In chapter 1 Level 5 in the story the player can now skip the cutscene when previously the player couldn't skip the cutscene

* The player can't use dash while wall sliding when the player could before which would waste Ivy's Stamina.

*Fixed the conditions to get the "What did I get myself Into" Achievement.
